decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).
Condition : 4 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 12 Willow Gardens.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northwestern or southeastern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - No part of the roof of the single-storey rear extension shall be used as or altered to form a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the approved plans, the front elevation of the extension hereby permitted shall be finished in red brick at ground floor level to a height matching the main house with pebble dashing above, and the northwest corner 	of the part two-storey side extension shall be constructed with a red brick quoin detail to match those on the existing front and side elevations.  This shall be permanently retained.

Condition : 8 - Before the erection of part two-storey side and rear extensions and erection of part single-storey side and rear extensions hereby permitted is carried out, the off-street parking shall be completed in accordance with Amended Drawing 040105/2 'B' received 18 August 2004 and shall be permanently retained.
description: Demolition of existing garage and erection of part two storey side and rear extensions and erection of part single storey side & rear extensions to dwellinghouse.
